info.title: HackStop REST API
info.description: Formal, versioned public REST API for the HackStop hackathon submission and judging platform. Enforces role-based isolation across visitors, participants, judges, organizers, and admins.

cookieAuth.name: session
cookieAuth.description: Session token passed in the session cookie.

bearerAuth.description: Session token passed in the Authorization header: Bearer <session_token>.

get.description: Public health check endpoint confirming database connectivity.

post.description: Signs in with email and password, establishing a session token cookie and X-Session-Token header.
Creates a new user with participant role. Public registration always assigns the participant role.

get.description: Returns profile of the user tied to the active session token.
Returns events owned by the authenticated organizer or all events for admin.

post.description: Creates a new hackathon event with rubric, tracks, and custom questions. Restricted to organizers and admins.

get.description: Returns event details by event UUID. Restricted to owner or admin.
Public unauthenticated endpoint to query submitted projects with full-text search and filters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query for title, tagline, description, team

post.description: Creates a draft or submitted project. Enforces deadline (returns 403 when event.submissions_close is past).

get.description: Returns private project draft/submission for team members.

404.description: Project not found in your team

put.description: Updates an existing draft or submission. Enforces deadline (403 when closed).

get.description: Public read of all comments on a submitted project.

post.description: Authenticated users can comment on submitted projects. Enforces hourly rate limits.

get.description: Returns teams the authenticated user belongs to.

post.description: Creates a team in an event. User becomes team leader. Max 1 team per event per user.

409.description: User already in a team for this event

get.description: Returns team and membership details for team members.

post.description: Authenticated participant joins a team using valid invite code. Enforces max 4 members and 1 team per event.

403.description: Invalid code, full team, or already in event team

get.summary: List assigned projects for authenticated judge
get.description: Returns projects assigned to the calling judge in their designated tracks. Backend enforces role isolation.
Returns rubric and existing scores for the assigned project. Strictly isolated to the assigned judge.

403.description: Not assigned to this project or wrong role

put.description: Saves partial or complete criterion scores and optional comment. Locked to assigned judge.

get.description: Returns scores submitted by the authenticated judge. Querying another judge's ID explicitly returns 403 Forbidden.

parameters.name: judge
parameters.description: Judge ID. Must match authenticated judge.

get.summary: List all judge assignments in event
get.description: Organizer view of all judge-project assignments for an event.

post.description: Batch manual assignment or round-robin algorithmic distribution across track judges.

get.description: Returns invited judges and track assignments for the event.

post.description: Invites a judge by email, creates account if needed, and assigns tracks.

get.description: Real-time metrics: assigned, completed, and percentage reviews per judge.
Returns calculated rankings. If called by non-organizers during active voting, returns HTTP 423 Locked.

423.description: Results locked while voting is open

post.description: Triggers on-demand calculation of z-score normalization across all scored criteria.

get.description: Returns criteria, weights, and max scores.

put.description: Updates rubric configuration. If scoring has already started, criterion count and scales are locked.

409.description: Cannot alter criteria count or scale after scoring has begun

get.description: Returns chronologically ordered audit entries for votes and comments.
Returns the authenticated user's submitted ratings for projects in the given event.

post.description: Rates a project 1-5 during active voting. Organizers and assigned judges are disqualified. Enforces hourly rate limits.

403.description: Voting window closed or actor disqualified

get.description: Generates CSV export of rankings, raw averages, and normalized scores. Restricted to organizer and admin.

200.description: CSV file containing rankings and scores
